acceptance.description: Benchmark arena handles versus object nodes for traversal, mutation, parse-like construction, retained memory and ergonomic examples.
Record reproducible environment/data and raw comparative measurements; identify identity/ownership tradeoffs.
Demonstrate the deliverable using only verified dependencies and this task; record actual API/output files and checks at the tested revision. Preserve earlier milestone behavior.

Measure borrowed-name lookup versus temporary string creation, repeated versus unique names, and owned text materialization. Record allocations and retained backing-storage costs with explicit persistence boundaries.
